source_description_html:
Made of fine carbon fiber, 100% made in Italy, extremely detailed both internal and external surfaces, it guarantees maximum strength and low weight. This new particular design has been studied in detail through aerodynamics and fluid dynamics studies to reduce the air pressure both on the lever guard itself and on the brake command at high speeds.
The new design of the lever guard has been created to favor a wide movement of the hand and wrist in the various riding phases and also to facilitate the rapid release of the hand in the event of a fall or accident.
In addition to being a fundamental element for safety, the Bonamici Racing carbon shift guard is a real design object that gives the bike a very beautiful and sporty look.
The peculiarity of the new carbon lever guard is that it is supplied with a titanium screw and it is possible to adjust its position both in the longitudinal axis and in the transversal axis thanks to a new bushing system mounted between the handlebar and the lever guard itself. One of a kind.
